sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If
you invest in our Common Stock, your interest will be diluted to the extent of the difference between the assumed offering price per
share and the pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value per share of Common Stock immediately after this offering. The
purchase price per Put Share in this offering is $2.00 pursuant to the Purchase Agreement. As
of June 30, 2026, our net tangible book value was approximately $16,655,784, or $0.42 per share of Common Stock. Our net tangible book
value per share represents the amount of our total tangible assets (which excludes capitalized website development costs and other intangibles,
unamortized original issue discount and deferred financing costs) reduced by the amount of our total liabilities and divided by the total
number of shares of our Common Stock outstanding as of June 30, 2026. After
